description: Graph utilities over a MAIAS file: get one screen, list screens/flows, reachability analysis, orphan detection, "what links here" for a screen id, a text outline of the structure (tree — show this to the user after creating or restructuring a document), and a Mermaid flowchart (mermaid — renders in GitHub/Claude/Obsidian). tree and mermaid return plain text, not JSON; mermaid accepts an optional flow to scope the diagram.

flow.description: mermaid: scope the diagram to one flow

refs.description: tree: append each screen's outbound targets and states

name: query
title: Query a MAIAS document graph
